games.name: Contra
games.world: Dense tropical military-industrial jungle bordering a fortified compound
games.terrain: Broken asphalt service road, muddy shoulders, bridges and concrete barriers
games.obstacles: Roadblocks, abandoned vehicles, sandbags, trenches, collapsed structures
games.enemies: Armed soldiers, patrol units, armored sentry, helicopter support
games.moves: Run, sprint, jump, slide, crouch, dodge, climb, rapid direction change
games.weapons: Assault rifle, heavy machine gun, explosive launcher
games.powerUps: Weapon upgrade crate, ammunition cache, temporary armor
games.abilities: Rapid fire, tactical dodge, precision burst, explosive strike
games.props: Military jeep, cargo truck, barricades, radio tower, fuel drums
games.camera: Low tracking shot, over-shoulder combat, wide establishing shot, handheld chase
games.vfx: Muzzle flashes, shell casings, sparks, smoke, rain spray, controlled explosions
games.sound: Heavy percussion, engine rumble, gunfire, rain, radio chatter, impact hits
games.realistic: Photorealistic cinematic military action while preserving fast arcade rhythm
frames: The Road
Hero enters the deserted road as distant alarms activate.
The Blockade
A patrol vehicle blocks the route and enemies emerge.
Incoming Fire
Hero takes cover as fire crosses the road.
Weapon Upgrade
Hero reaches a supply crate and upgrades the weapon.
Escalation
An armored enemy arrives; the road becomes a moving battlefield.
Breakthrough
Hero uses the environment and explosives to break through.
The Gate
A massive gate opens, revealing a larger enemy force.
Cliffhanger
Hero runs toward the gate as the screen cuts to black on a new threat.

games.name: Mario
games.world: Mushroom Kingdom with bright surface grasslands, underground passages, aquatic courses and fortified castles
games.terrain: Grassland, underground stone passages, water courses, elevated platforms, castle interiors and flagpole approaches
games.obstacles: Pits, pipes, blocks, moving platforms, water hazards, fire bars, Podoboos and castle traps
games.enemies: Goombas, Koopa Troopas, Buzzy Beetles, Piranha Plants, Cheep-Cheeps, Hammer Bros., Lakitu and Bowser
games.moves: Run, sprint, jump, stomp, swim, duck, climb vines and change direction in midair
games.weapons: Fireballs when Fire Mario is active; direct stomp attacks
games.powerUps: Super Mushroom, Fire Flower, Starman, 1-Up Mushroom
games.abilities: Size growth, fireball attack, temporary invincibility, underwater swimming and power-up transformation
games.props: Question blocks, brick blocks, coins, pipes, platforms, flagpole, castle bridge and axe
games.camera: Side-scrolling tracking, wide level establishing shots, low jump-following shots and close-up obstacle reveals
games.vfx: Coin bursts, fireballs, block impacts, water spray, star glow, enemy defeat effects and castle fire hazards
games.sound: Driving platform-game rhythm, jump accents, coin chimes, power-up cues, enemy impacts and castle tension
games.realistic: Cinematic fantasy adventure interpretation while preserving readable platforming rhythm and escalating level hazards
frames: The Kingdom Road
Hero enters the Mushroom Kingdom grassland and begins the forward run toward the distant castle.
First Obstacles
Enemy patrols and environmental gaps force the hero to jump, stomp and use blocks to advance.
Underground Route
The path drops into an underground passage where pipes, blocks and tighter hazards change the rhythm.
Power-Up
Hero discovers a power-up and gains a stronger capability before the next escalation.
Water and Air Assault
The route shifts through water or elevated terrain as aquatic and airborne enemies increase pressure.
Castle Approach
The hero reaches a fortified castle section filled with fire hazards and precision timing challenges.
Final Threshold
The hero crosses the castle bridge, defeats the final guardian and reaches the rescue objective.
New Kingdom Threat
The objective is achieved, but the wider kingdom and next world are revealed as the next adventure begins.

games.name: Road Fighter
games.world: High-speed intercity highway network progressing through open countryside, bridges, coastline, mountains and forest
games.terrain: Multi-lane asphalt highway, bridge sections, coastal road, mountain road and forest road
games.obstacles: Dense traffic, lane-changing cars, oil patches, barriers, roadside edges and fuel pressure
games.enemies: Yellow traffic cars, red and cyan lane-changing cars, blue rival cars and heavy trucks
games.moves: Accelerate, brake, steer, lane change, overtake, recover from skid and maintain racing line
games.weapons: None; speed, positioning and collision avoidance are the core tools
games.powerUps: Fuel-refill vehicles and route-based fuel opportunities
games.abilities: High-speed acceleration, precision lane control, slip recovery and traffic threading
games.props: Race car, traffic cars, trucks, roadside barriers, fuel vehicles, bridge structures and finish marker
games.camera: Low rear chase camera, hood-level speed shots, wide traffic reveals and aggressive lateral tracking
games.vfx: Road spray, tire smoke, speed streaks, reflections, collision sparks and environmental motion blur
games.sound: High-rev engine, tire squeal, wind rush, traffic impacts, acceleration cues and finish-line intensity
games.realistic: Photorealistic high-speed road-action interpretation while preserving arcade racing rhythm and fuel management
frames: The Highway Start
The red racing car launches onto the highway with limited fuel and immediate traffic pressure.
Traffic Weave
Straight-line traffic and lane-changing cars force rapid steering and overtaking decisions.
Rival Pressure
Aggressive rival cars begin changing lanes into the racing line, increasing collision risk.
Fuel Opportunity
Fuel pressure becomes critical and the driver targets a special fuel-refill vehicle without losing speed.
Oil and Skid
An oil patch destabilizes the car, forcing a controlled recovery before the next road section.
Bridge and Coast
The route opens into a bridge and coastal stretch where speed and lane discipline become the dominant challenge.
Mountain to Forest Run
The course transitions through mountain terrain toward the forest, with traffic and fuel pressure still active.
Final Sprint
The driver maintains speed through the final traffic sequence and reaches the finish before fuel or time is exhausted.

games.name: Kung Fu

games.terrain: Temple floors, narrow combat corridors, stairways, open floor sections and boss arenas
games.obstacles: Enemy formations, thrown weapons, snakes, fireballs, time pressure and floor transitions
games.enemies: Grabbers, knife throwers, stick fighters, Tom Tom Brothers, Giants, snakes, fire-breathing dragon and floor bosses
games.moves: Walk, crouch, jump, punch, kick, jump punch, jump kick and rapid directional changes
games.weapons: Punches, kicks and jumping attacks; no persistent weapon inventory
games.powerUps: No core persistent power-up system; progression comes from combat skill and survival
games.abilities: Low punch, high punch, low kick, high kick, jump attack, crouch evasion and enemy-pattern recognition
games.props: Temple floors, staircases, doors, combat spaces and boss arenas
games.camera: Side-on tracking, low combat angle, tight impact close-ups and vertical stair-transition shots
games.vfx: Impact flashes, dust, weapon trails, fireballs, sparks, debris and dramatic boss effects
games.sound: Martial-arts impacts, footwork, enemy cries, weapon throws, fire effects, timer tension and boss cues
games.realistic: Grounded cinematic martial-arts action while preserving the game's compact side-scrolling combat rhythm
frames: Temple Entrance
Thomas enters the Devil's Temple and begins the climb toward Sylvia.
First Floor Assault
Grabbers and knife throwers force Thomas to establish the punch, kick and jump-combat rhythm.
First Boss
A stronger floor guardian blocks the staircase and must be defeated before the ascent continues.
Second and Third Floors
Enemy patterns diversify and the vertical climb becomes more demanding under time pressure.
Heavy Threats
Stronger attackers, Giants, snakes and projectile hazards force tighter defensive timing.
Upper Floor Boss
A major guardian controls the route upward and introduces a stronger combat escalation.
Mr. X Threshold
Thomas reaches the top section and confronts the final obstacle before Sylvia's rescue.
Rescue and Next Cycle
Mr. X is defeated, Sylvia is reached, and the combat loop establishes the next harder cycle.

frames: Forest Entry
Kage enters the forest and begins the rescue mission through dense terrain and enemy patrols.
Forest Guardian
Yohboh and Shinobi resistance increases as Kage uses trees, jumps and shuriken to advance.
Secret Passage
Kage reaches the underground passage leading toward the moat and the castle approach.
Shinobi Ambush
Blue Shinobi swarm the passage, turning the route into a concentrated combat challenge.
Fortress Wall
Kage emerges at the fortress and begins a vertical climb across walls and platforms.
Castle Assault
Red Shinobi and stronger enemies pressure Kage as he approaches the castle interior.
Princess Threshold
Kage reaches the castle objective and confronts the forces protecting Princess Kiri.
Rescue and New Season
The princess is rescued, the season changes and the next cycle of the mission begins.
